objectives.text: Harvest five eligible blocks barehanded and unarmored with your head underwater
Dodge five skeleton arrows without a damaging hit
Face the moon from a boat for ten seconds
Walk ten consecutive blocks through fire
A little kindness might defuse a dangerous situation
Fall from world height to the depths and survive
Find a place to rest against the foundations of the world
Fight five hostile creatures barehanded while blind
Defeat a full-health Wither using only your fists
Break five logs with your fists
Break five glass blocks or panes with your fists to unlock Silk Touch
Break twenty cobwebs with your fists
Break twenty dirt blocks with your fists
Break twenty grass plants with your fists
Break twenty logs with your fists
Enter the Nether as a Monk

skills.title: Reserved Fist
skills.description: Reserve the first hotbar slot for your fist.

skills.title: Armor Lock
skills.description: Your training requires freedom from armor.

skills.title: Water Breathing
skills.description: Breathe freely underwater.

skills.title: Aqua Affinity
skills.description: Mine underwater at normal submerged mining speed with bare hands and no armor. Floating mining penalty still applies.

skills.title: Patient Defense
skills.description: Gain Resistance I after two seconds without attacking.

skills.title: Animal Friendship
skills.description: Pet eligible animals with empty hands.

skills.title: Arrow Catching
skills.description: Automatically return incoming arrows and ghast fireballs toward your aim; legacy catching handles other eligible arrows.

skills.title: Step Assist
skills.description: Step up higher blocks while not sneaking.

skills.title: Water Walking
skills.description: Walk across the surface of water; crouch to dive.

skills.title: Fire Discipline
skills.description: Become immune to fire and lava damage.

skills.title: Creeper Kiss
skills.description: Pacify eligible creepers barehanded.

skills.title: Feather Fall
skills.description: Ignore fall damage.

skills.title: Wall Climbing
skills.description: Toggle native climbing against solid walls.

skills.title: Bedrock Rest
skills.description: Rest against exposed bedrock without resetting your spawn.

skills.title: Feign Death
skills.description: Toggle with your Feign Death key; pause regeneration and shed ordinary enemy aggro until you move or attack.

skills.title: Blindness Ordeal
skills.description: Use the ordeal binding to practice blind combat.

skills.title: Night Vision
skills.description: See in darkness.

skills.title: Purification
skills.description: Clear harmful effects quickly without interrupting an active ordeal.

skills.title: Momentum Glide
skills.description: Toggle native wingless gliding.

skills.title: Wooden Hands
skills.description: Double base barehand mining speed on tool-mineable blocks; no material permissions.

skills.title: Silk Touch
skills.description: Select Silk Touch to harvest eligible blocks intact with your bare hands; replaces Fortune while active and never bypasses material harvest requirements.

skills.title: Shearing Hands
skills.description: Select this native tool form in place of your empty hand.

skills.title: Earth Shaping
skills.description: Select this native tool form in place of your empty hand.

skills.title: Cultivating Hands
skills.description: Select this native tool form in place of your empty hand.

skills.title: Wood Shaping
skills.description: Select this native tool form in place of your empty hand.

skills.title: Otherworld Sight
skills.description: See the Otherworld without a potion.

skills.title: Iesnium Palm
skills.description: Native Iesnium harvesting, subject to sight and harvest permission.

skills.title: Iron Palm
skills.description: Add 3.8 raw fist damage per rank.

skills.title: Fist Tempo
skills.description: Increase fist attack speed by 0.4 per rank.

skills.title: Forceful Palm
skills.description: Increase native barehand attack knockback by one per rank.

skills.title: Flying Kick
skills.description: A charged aerial critical attack at least one block above ground becomes a full-damage area kick; radius increases from 3 to 5 blocks. No additional cooldown.

skills.title: Reaping Palm
skills.description: Gain one native Looting level per rank against scoped hostiles.

skills.title: Stunning Palm
skills.description: Ten ticks of stun per rank, with five seconds of enemy-wide recovery.

skills.title: Natural Armor
skills.description: Gain two natural armor per rank.

skills.title: Natural Toughness
skills.description: Gain two toughness per rank.

skills.title: Protection
skills.description: Gain two enchantment protection points per rank while unarmored; native protection cap applies.

skills.title: Vitality
skills.description: Gain four maximum health per rank.

skills.title: Rooted Body
skills.description: Gain ten percentage points of knockback resistance per rank.

skills.title: Regeneration
skills.description: Recover 0.2 health per second per rank.

skills.title: Hunger Discipline
skills.description: Reduce exhaustion ten percentage points per rank.

skills.title: Swift Step
skills.description: Increase walk speed by 0.01 per rank, double intrinsic bonus when sprinting.

skills.title: Monk Leap
skills.description: Increase jump impulse by 0.1 per rank.

skills.title: Depth Strider
skills.description: Improve water movement efficiency by one third per rank.

skills.title: Soul Step
skills.description: Move across soul sand and soul soil with native Soul Speed I–III equivalent speed and no soul sand slowdown.

skills.title: Silent Step
skills.description: Increase sneak movement ratio by 0.15 per rank.

skills.title: Hide in Shadows
skills.description: While sneaking, reduce hostile acquisition range by ten percentage points per rank.

skills.title: Danger Sense
skills.description: Sense mobs targeting you within eight blocks per rank.

skills.title: Dodge
skills.description: Chance to evade a verified direct hit: 10/20/30%. Area damage and unclassified damage cannot be dodged.

skills.title: Hand Mining
skills.description: Increase native barehand mining-speed factor; 49 with Wooden Hands at full rank.

skills.title: Fortunate Hands
skills.description: Gain one native Fortune level per rank for scoped pickaxe blocks.

skills.title: Inner Reservoir
skills.description: Increase personal magical capacity through supported native attributes.

skills.title: Inner Wellspring
skills.description: Recover personal magical resources more quickly.

skills.title: Inner Thrift
skills.description: Reduce supported personal magical resource costs.

skills.title: Inner Potency
skills.description: Improve personal spell power in supported magic systems.

skills.title: Arcane Attunement
skills.description: Improve native casting speed and spell cooldown recovery.
